# Building Against Non-Homebrew Dependencies

## History

Originally Homebrew was a build-from-source package manager and all user environment variables and non-Homebrew-installed software were available to builds. Since then Homebrew added `Requirement`s to specify dependencies on non-Homebrew software (such as those provided by `brew cask` like X11/XQuartz), the `superenv` build system to strip out unspecified dependencies, environment filtering to stop
